segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company formed to acquire or combine with an energy-sector business through an initial business combination.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on June 6, 2025, as a Cayman Islands exempted company for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities
